items.q: In this band was Ike Quebec

ctx.x: I say, "Okay, the price is good," you know. Scale for musicians. He didn't know I was gonna bring in like four trumpets and three trombones. Six saxophones with myself. Now I'm playing --
In this band was Ike Quebec and -- whatchacallem, tenor player?
